data.exact_reserve_text: During 2016 we were able to release prior year reserves of $180.2m (2015: $177.6m).
data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2623 reported a net release of $180.2 million in prior year reserves for 2016, representing a 5.86% reduction of its opening gross claims outstanding. This favourable development was primarily driven by a generally favourable claims environment and increased reserve releases from the maturing post-recession portfolio from 2012 onwards, particularly in the specialty lines division. This was partially offset by lower releases in short-tail classes due to reduced margins.
raw_causal_phrases: Overall, the claims environment has been favourable during 2016 with a relatively modest incidence of natural catastrophe claims notifications.
Our specialty lines division increased their reserve releases as the post recession portfolio from 2012 onwards matures
This counter-balanced lower releases on short tail classes where the mechanical effect that reduced margins have on reserve releases is now visable.
data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure of -180.2m is explicitly stated as a 'release' in the narrative and is consistent with the sum of divisional releases. However, the context (e.g., 'Releases as a percentage of net earned premium') strongly suggests this is a NET figure (after reinsurance). No gross prior year development figure was available from other sources (e.g., movement notes or claims development triangles).
